_meta.notes: Per-country food production trend from FAOSTAT's Gross Production Index (Food, 2014-2016 = 100). Replaces the hand-authored FDRS c[2] literal, which carried weight 0.11 with no source and no data year. Falling production scores high. Countries with fewer than 5 index points in the window carry a null score and quality_flag 'partial' — never 0. Covered 185 countries, 185 scored.

AFG.source: FAOSTAT Production Indices (Gross Production Index, Food, 2014-2016 = 100)
AFG.method: OLS slope of the gross food production index over 2015-2024, expressed as average annual % change against the window mean, then mapped to 0-100 fragility where only sustained DECLINE scores high (-5%/yr -> 100, -1%/yr -> 20, flat or growing -> 0).
